newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Key Brazil soybean area seen cold and dry - Somar.
newsitem.headline: Key Brazil soybean area seen cold and dry - Somar.

text.p: The weather was once again seen cold and dry in Brazil's key southern soybean growing regions with a high pressure system preventing any significant rains, independent meteorologists Somar said.
Isolated rains were forecast for Mato Grosso state, mainly in the north-west of the state.

Last week, a cold front caused isolated showers in the south, reaching 44 mm in Sao Luis Gonzaga and 27 mm in Passo Fundo. By the time the cold front reached Parana state, though, it had lost its strength and rainfall totals were below 10 mm.
